summary: Authentication architecture is already represented by the manager’s dependency-ordered Sprint 2 plan; no additional task was assigned.

messages.content: Architecture decisions: retain stdlib http.server + sqlite3; expose register/login endpoints returning signed, expiring JWTs; send bearer tokens from the static UI; scope all task SQL by authenticated user_id; store salted password hashes rather than plaintext.

decisions: Keep server.py responsible for JWT issuance/validation and request authorization.
Keep database.py responsible for users and task ownership schema/migrations.
Keep static/index.html responsible for session token storage and Authorization headers.
